arxiv-2606-17917: Olha Shulika and colleagues assess on-demand pooled transit services without assuming demand patterns. arxiv-2606-18117: Yugao Zhu and colleagues integrate memetic operations into a multi-level framework for large k-way hypergraph partitioning with IMPart. plos-pone-0003417: Clinicians compared TB tests head-to-head in this 2008 multicenter study. plos-pone-0004017: In 2008, Saaf, Tengvall-Linder, and Chang profiled the genes of itchy skin. Atopic eczema skin showed inflammatory genes turned up and lipid genes turned down. plos-pone-0004117: In 2009, Ellenbogen, Hulbert, and Jiang showed sleep guarding memory overnight. The sleeping brain's hard work boosted verbal memory's resistance to interference. plos-pone-0004217: In 2009, Finn, Tregenza, and Norman watched dolphins cook with their flippers. Dolphins showed complex prey handling while preparing cuttlefish meals. plos-pone-0004417: In 2009, Young, Martel, and Young declared tiny nanobacteria dead. The so-called nanobacteria proved to be calcium-homeostasis remnants, not life. plos-pone-0004517: In 2009, Moodie, Pai, and Klein asked whether HIV drugs harm the liver long-term. Long-term liver effects of antiretroviral therapy in HIV/HCV co-infection were compared. plos-pone-0004617: In 2009, a team hunted drugs to keep stray cancer cells asleep. Computer screens found small molecules breaking a cancer protein handshake. The candidates blocked spread wake-up calls. The work offers a fresh new target. The stray cells were dormant.
plos-pone-0004717: In 2009, a team found a guard keeping a gene switch clean anew. Parp1 sat in the Dnmt1 switch and kept it clean. The enzyme guarded the switch well. The study maps cancer gene wiring. The tagging is off-kilter here.
plos-pone-0329717: Radiotherapy can paradoxically spur cancer invasion — and something in blood plasma carries the signal. plos-pone-0355417: Orthopaedic surgery remains one of medicine’s least diverse specialties. This paper asked where diversity currently stands in orthopaedic surgery residency applications. The numbers show honestly how far the pipeline has come — and how far it still has to go.
plos-pone-0356617: Lithium’s isotopes behave subtly differently in radical-pair reactions — quantum details with real consequences. plos-pone-0357117: GP practices across the UK are morphing into team-based, multiprofessional care centers. plos-pone-0357917: Serious disease reshapes lives long before diagnosis — and long after treatment ends. plos-pone-0356917: Critically ill children on prolonged opioids face brutal withdrawal when the drugs stop. plos-pone-0354517: ‘My dog is my life’ — for homeless people, the bond with a companion animal runs profoundly deep. plos-pone-0348517: Plant compounds might do double duty against flu and human metapneumovirus. plos-pone-0356817: Etching silicon precisely is the foundation of the entire semiconductor industry. This paper studied the etching characteristics and profile simulation of silicon. The detailed etch science helps chipmakers carve ever-smaller features with confidence.
plos-pone-0357017: Normalizing muscle mass by height squared creates a paradox that misclassifies patients. plos-pone-0355717: Liver cancer’s driver mutations differ between populations — and Chinese patients were understudied. This paper examined driver mutation impact in Chinese hepatocellular carcinoma. plos-pone-0354817: Immunoglobulin is a precious, expensive therapy — and Canadian physicians must manage it wisely. This qualitative study explored how they do so. plos-pone-0354917: Counting insects in light traps over seasons and years reveals population rhythms invisible in snapshots. plos-pone-0353017: Mass coral bleaching and Cyclone Megan battered the Groote Archipelago’s reefs — and baselines were urgently needed. plos-pone-0355117: Septic shock kills through cascading organ failure — but an unlikely drug combination might help. plos-pone-0355217: People living with HIV face urate dysregulation — hyperuricemia and gout — at poorly quantified rates. This paper published the protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis. The planned synthesis will measure a metabolic burden that HIV care has largely overlooked.
plos-pone-0353217: Fusarium pathogens — crop killers — meet their match in endophytic fungi. plos-pone-0353417: Hebei Province’s place names — their cultural landscapes evolving through space and time. This paper traced that spatiotemporal evolution and its drivers. europmc-pmc6647117: Frontotemporal dementia - which steals personality and language rather than memory - runs strongly in families.
